PolyWorks Inspector

PolyWorks Inspector supports 3D measurement planning, dimensional analysis and inspection reporting.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Prepare a measurement plan

Start from the selected scans, photographs or measured geometry and coordinate basis. In the intended PolyWorks Inspector preview, prepare a measurement plan; the visible result is an aligned capture set with coverage and registration state visible. Review scale, overlap, control points and residual error before accepting or exporting it.

Align measured and nominal geometry

Begin with the cleaned capture and nominal reference. In the intended PolyWorks Inspector preview, align measured and nominal geometry; the visible result is a segmented, reconstructed or compared geometry result. Review noise, holes, alignment strategy and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Publish an inspection report

Use the reviewed mesh, surface, cloud or inspection characteristics. In the intended PolyWorks Inspector preview, publish an inspection report; the visible result is an export or report tied to the captured source and coordinate system. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and downstream fitness before accepting or exporting it.
